verdict.rationale: Search analytics (top queries, no-result queries, click-through) is a fair axis for a search engine, so it applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any analytics dashboard, query logging, zero-result reporting, or click tracking in Orama or Orama Cloud. The pack covers search modes, facets, the answer engine, the MCP server and data sources only.

support.subject: As a founder, built-in analytics show top queries, no-result queries, and click-through so I know what users search for and miss
